Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293266. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target. Join activities to compound_records and molecule_dictionary for molecule identifiers. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
